info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Anthophy Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Anthophy Recliner Detail Management API enables the dynamic creation of detailed information for Anthophy Recliners within the catalog. This endpoint facilitates the onboarding of new recliner models, ensuring that relevant specifications, features, and pricing are documented accurately. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and e-commerce teams looking to enhance their inventory with comprehensive product details. Leveraging this API streamlines the catalog management process, providing end-users with easy access to up-to-date information.

post.summary: Creates details for an Anthophy recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit detailed information for an Anthophy recliner. Use this operation to input specifications, features, and additional attributes that describe the product.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details necessary to create or update an Anthophy recliner. It should include all relevant properties such as model, dimensions, and options. Please ensure the information adheres to the defined schema for proper processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the relevant details.
